description: This file defines API routes for managing and streaming videos in a FastAPI application, including listing videos, fetching details, and handling video streaming with HTTP Range support.

classes.name: VideoOut
classes.description: Schema representing video metadata to be sent out in responses.

classes.name: VideoListResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a list response containing multiple videos and total count.

methods.name: VideoOut _to_video_out(request: Request, video)
methods.description: Converts a video object into a VideoOut schema, including generating a stream URL.

methods.name: VideoListResponse list_videos( request: Request, q: str | None = None, tag: str | None = None, limit: int = 24, offset: int = 0, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list or search videos, supports filtering by query and tags, pagination.

methods.name: VideoOut get_video(id: int, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches and returns metadata for a specific video by ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: stream_video(id: int, request: Request, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Streams the video file with HTTP Range support for seeking, handles range requests and constructs response headers accordingly.

ctags.name: get_video
ctags.pattern: /^def get_video(id: int, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> VideoOut:$/
ctags.signature: (id: int, request: Request, db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.name: list_videos
ctags.signature: ( request: Request, q: str | None = None, tag: str | None = None, limit: int = 24, offset: int = 0, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: stream_video
ctags.pattern: /^def stream_video(id: int, request: Request, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (id: int, request: Request, response: Response, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
